title: How strongly the data prefer evolving dark energy over a cosmological constant
description: Bar chart of the preference for dark energy that changes with time over Einstein's cosmological constant, in standard deviations (sigma), against the 5 sigma usually required for a discovery. DESI DR2 BAO with the CMB: 3.1. Adding supernovae: Pantheon+ 2.8, Union3 3.8, DES five-year 4.2. With the DES supernovae recalibrated (DES-Dovekie, 2026): 3.2. The full Dark Energy Survey on its own (2026): 2.2. Data: DESI Collaboration, Phys. Rev. D 112, 083515 (2025); Popovic et al., MNRAS (2026); DES Collaboration, arXiv:2605.27221 (2026).
heading: EVOLVING DARK ENERGY · PREFERENCE IN σ · 5σ IS A DISCOVERY
